newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea to make announcement on N.Korean defector.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea to make announcement on N.Korean defector.

text.p: South Korea will make an announcement on North Korea's top ideologue Hwang Jang-yop on Tuesday, a foreign ministry official said.
South Korea had earlier said an announcement would be made once Hwang landed in a third country after leaving China.
"The announcement on Hwang will be made between 4.00 and 5.00 p.m. (0700 and 0800 GMT)," the official said.
A ministry spokesman declined comment on domestic news reports that Hwang left Beijing on Tuesday nearly five weeks after seeking asylum in a South Korean diplomatic mission.
Yonhap Television News quoted a government source in Seoul as saying that Hwang, ranked 24th in Pyongyang's hierarchy, headed for a southeast Asian country.
A China Southern Airlines flight believed to be carrying Hwang took off on Tuesday morning from China's southeastern port city of Xiamen for Manila, Chinese officials said.
